name: The Pink Beam Transmission
summary: PKD reports that following the fish-sign encounter, a pink-colored beam of light addressed him for several weeks, transmitting information he later transcribed as 'music-color-math triune' annotation.
description: Beginning around February 20, 1974 and continuing for weeks, PKD reports that a beam of pink-colored light projected information into him. The transmissions were not auditory in the ordinary sense — they registered as triune information legible simultaneously as music, color, and mathematics. PKD compared the form to medieval illuminated manuscripts. He reports learning (1) that his infant son Christopher had a previously undiagnosed inguinal hernia (subsequently medically confirmed — see THEO_1977_PROOF_OF_DAUGHTER_GLAUCOMA companion record), (2) that the world is in 70 AD Rome under the overlay of late-twentieth-century California, (3) that Latin and Koine Greek are accessible to him in a way that he cannot otherwise read.

pkd_interpretations.interpretation: There is a 'they' transmitting to me, possibly a non-human intelligence in orbit.
The transmissions originate from a Soviet satellite operated by Lem-as-front; the experience is psychological warfare directed at me as a SF author.
The transmitter may be Phil Dick himself from a future timeline addressing his past self.
Horselover Fat's pink beam in *VALIS* names this as a Vast Active Living Intelligence System.

scholar_interpretations.interpretation: Arnold reads the pink beam as a TLE photopsia compounded by sleep deprivation and orthomolecular vitamin overload.
Davis frames the pink-beam transmissions within a comparative-religious frame including Aquarius-age California visionaries (McKenna, RAW, Wilson).
Kripal places the experience in a religious-studies frame as exemplary American visionary religiosity (cf. Mutants and Mystics).

primary_sources.excerpt: Pink beam descriptions across hundreds of segments.

primary_quote: The color, musical score, math triune info: like an illuminated manuscript from the Medieval period.
pkd_doubt_evidence: The Exegesis is partly a sustained record of his doubt about this very transmission.
